train_encoder_resnet: train a ResNet encoder to recover latent codes and camera matrices from StyleNeRF generated images
run_VGGLoss: compute perceptual VGG19 feature matching loss between source and target image tensors
run_d_logistic_loss: compute logistic discriminator loss combining real and fake prediction softplus penalties
run_d_r1_loss: compute R1 gradient penalty on real images for discriminator regularization
run_g_nonsaturating_loss: compute non-saturating generator loss using softplus on negative fake predictions
